[blz-tooltip] {
  --tooltip-vertical-transform: calc(100% + var(--global-size-150));

  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;

  /* Fixes Safari bug where positioning context is lost in complex layouts. This creates a new stacking context. */
  transform: translate(0);
}
.blz-tooltip,
.blz-tooltip-extension {
  display: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  pointer-events: all;
  position: absolute;
  -webkit-user-select: text;
          user-select: text;

.blz-tooltip {
  background-color: var(--semantic-color-background-info-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--tooltip-color-border-primary);
  border-radius: var(--global-size-50);
  bottom: 0;
  font: var(--tooltip-font-text);
  left: 50%;
  max-width: min(
    calc(100vw - (var(--global-size-150) * 6)),
    calc(360px - var(--global-size-150) * 2)

  margin: 0;

<h2>Hearthstone Updates</h2>

<h3>Standard Card Changes</h3>

<p><em>Dev Comment: Well met! With </em>CATACLYSM <em>now live and Standard freshly rotated, we’ve been closely watching the new Standard environment take shape as you experiment with a wide range of decks and strategies. With the meta still evolving, this patch focuses on reining in a few clear outliers and giving a small boost to some budding archetypes. As always, we will be keeping a close eye on how these changes land and look forward to seeing how the playing field continues to develop.</em></p>

<p>Hamuul Runetotem</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: Start of Game: If each spell in your deck is Nature, Imbue your Hero Power. Repeat this every 2 spells you cast.</li>
	<li>New: Start of Game: If each spell in your deck is Nature, Imbue your Hero Power. Repeat this every 3 spells you cast.</li>
</ul>

<p><img alt="HS_DRUID_EDR_845_enUS_HamuulRunetotem-114858_NORMAL.png" data-id="24272781" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/5E9LLF7KUOID1774918155124.png"></p>

<p>Crystalspine Cub</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: 1/2.</li>
	<li>New: 1/1.</li>
</ul>

<p><img alt="HS_DRUID_CATA_130_enUS_CrystalspineCub-122966_NORMAL.png" data-id="24273460" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/C9C1U45J0AR41774918155109.png"></p>

<p>Wildwood Circle</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: [3 mana]</li>
	<li>New: [4 mana]</li>
</ul>

<p><img alt="HS_DRUID_CATA_134_enUS_WildwoodCircle-122971_NORMAL.png" data-id="24272827" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/JYEHXP9ZPP371774918155390.png"></p>

<p><em>Dev Comment: In Standard, Druid has stood out in both popularity and power and has been warping the meta. To address that, we are taking a more comprehensive approach by adjusting several key cards. These changes are aimed at toning down Druid’s ability to dominate both the early and late game.</em></p>

<p>Skywall Sentinel</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: 0/3.</li>
	<li>New: 0/2.</li>
</ul>

<p><img alt="HS_SHAMAN_CATA_565_enUS_SkywallSentinel-122953_NORMAL.png" data-id="24273461" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/15PQ87F8BB7B1774918155890.png"></p>

<p>Flight of the Firehawk</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: Draw two minions of different minion types. Give them +2/+2.</li>
	<li>New: Draw two minions of different minion types. Give them +1/+1.</li>
</ul>

<p><img alt="HS_SHAMAN_TLC_222_enUS_FlightoftheFirehawk-117606_NORMAL.png" data-id="24272782" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/4CKB341J61XU1774918156006.png"></p>

<p><em>Dev Comment: Shaman has also proven to be a strong presence, though not to the same degree as Druid. Here, we are taking a lighter touch by shaving some power off a couple of cards to keep the class in line as the meta continues to evolve.</em></p>

<p>Gladiatorial Combat</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: [5 mana]</li>
	<li>New: [6 mana]</li>
</ul>

<p><img alt="HS_WARRIOR_TIME_870_enUS_GladiatorialCombat-119778_NORMAL.png" data-id="24272828" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/GMXLG71RW6IX1774918156195.png"></p>

<p><em>Dev Comment: For Gladiatorial Combat, this adjustment is less about raw power and more about play pattern. While it has not been a major outlier yet, we want to proactively curb a style of gameplay that can become frustrating when it ramps into large threats too quickly.</em></p>

<ul>

	<li>New: 4/1.</li>
</ul>

<p><em>Dev Comment: On the buff side, we’ve seen some excitement around building decks with these cards, so we’re giving them a small boost to help realize their potential.</em></p>

<h3>Wild Card Changes</h3>

<p>Lightspeed</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: Give a minion +1/+2 and Rush. Repeatable this turn.</li>
	<li>New: Echo. Give a minion +1/+2 and Rush.</li>
	<li><em>Dev Comment: We are updating Lightspeed to use Echo to prevent zero‑cost interactions and abusive play patterns.</em></li>
</ul>

<p><img alt="HS_PRIEST_GDB_457_enUS_Lightspeed-111076_NORMAL.png" data-id="24273462" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/VXXEWTUPVHGR1774918159098.png"></p>

<p>Astral Communion</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: [4 mana]</li>
	<li>New: [5 mana]</li>
	<li><em>Dev Comment: Astral Communion is receiving a light adjustment to slow down a ramp strategy that has grown more consistent over time, while still preserving its identity as a fun and iconic Druid deck.</em></li>
</ul>

<p><img alt="HS_DRUID_AT_043_enUS_AstralCommunion-2785_NORMAL.png" data-id="24272829" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/WFCIZ7VN5YTV1774918159166.png"></p>

<p>Grand Magister Rommath</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: Battlecry: Recast each spell you've cast this game that didn't start in your deck.</li>
	<li>New: Battlecry: Recast each spell you've cast this game that didn't start in your deck. (Once per game)</li>
	<li><em>Dev Comment: Grand Magister Rommath is being limited to once per game to address a highly repetitive and frustrating play pattern that we do not want to be a defining part of the format.</em></li>
</ul>

<p><img alt="HS_MAGE_RLK_803_enUS_GrandMagisterRommath-84003_NORMAL.png" data-id="24272783" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/A3HLAUGO9AWU1774918159086.png"></p>

<p><img alt="HS_Divider_Generic_760x171_EK01.png" data-id="23747266" src="https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/5j/5J8DWFP6WXMJ1636657718794.png"></p>

<h2>Battlegrounds Updates</h2>

<p><em>Dev Comment: This marks our final major balance patch of the season. We’re happy with where the meta and the Timewarped Tavern have landed overall, so we took a lighter approach this time around.</em></p>

<ul>
	<li><em>We’ve toned down Metal Dispenser and Silky Shimmermoth, which have been overperforming, while offering modest buffs to Dragons, Pirates, Murlocs, and Elementals to help keep things fresh.</em></li>
	<li><em>For Timewarped cards, our focus was on improving or removing underperformers so your shop offerings stay fun and interesting.</em></li>
	<li><em>We brought back the Money Match and Golganneth’s Tempest Anomalies after hearing how much these fan favorites were missed.</em></li>
</ul>

<p><em>With the next season just around the corner, we’re excited to share more details with you soon. We’ll see you in the Tavern!</em></p>

	<li>Alexstrasza<span style="white-space:pre"> now has </span>10 armor, and<span style="white-space:pre"> </span>8 in Duos.</li>
	<li>Buttons<span style="white-space:pre"> now has </span>16 armor, and<span style="white-space: pre;"> </span>14 in Duos.</li>
	<li>Cariel Roame<span style="white-space:pre"> now has </span>18 armor, and<span style="white-space: pre;"> </span>16 in Duos.</li>
	<li>C'Thun<span style="white-space:pre"> now has </span>20 armor, and<span style="white-space: pre;"> </span>18 in Duos.</li>
	<li>Death Speaker Blackthorn<span style="white-space:pre"> now has </span>18 armor, and<span style="white-space: pre;"> </span>16 in Duos.</li>
	<li>Jim Raynor<span style="white-space:pre"> now has </span>16 armor, and<span style="white-space: pre;"> </span>14 in Duos.</li>
	<li>Kerrigan, Queen of Blades<span style="white-space:pre"> now has </span>14 armor, and<span style="white-space:pre"> </span>12 in Duos.</li>
	<li>Millhouse Manastorm<span style="white-space:pre"> now has </span>16 armor, and<span style="white-space: pre;"> </span>14 in Duos.</li>

	<li>Tess Greymane<span style="white-space:pre"> now has </span>17 armor, and<span style="white-space: pre;"> </span>15 in Duos.</li>
</ul>

<h3>Timewarp Changes</h3>

<h4>Timewarp Pool Changes</h4>

<p>Removed:</p>

<ul>
	<li>Timewarped Relaxer</li>
	<li>Timewarped Guard</li>
	<li>Timewarped Grease Bot</li>
	<li>Timewarped Karathress</li>
	<li>Timewarped Goldrinn</li>
</ul>

<h4>Timewarp Text and Stat Changes</h4>

<p>Timewarped Lucky Egg</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: In two turns, Discover a Golden Tier 7 minion to transform into. (2 turns left!)</li>
	<li>New: In two turns, choose from three Golden Tier 7 minions to transform into. (2 turns left!)</li>
	<li><em>Dev Comment: This is a text-only change for clarity.</em></li>
</ul>

<p>Timewarped Raider</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: Golden version: After you play a card from Tier 4 or above, give your Pirates +6/+4.</li>
	<li>New: Golden version: After you play a card from Tier 4 or above, give your Pirates +3/+2 twice.</li>
	<li><em>Dev Comment: Changed to match other Golden Pirates.</em></li>
</ul>

<p>Timewarped Caretaker</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: Deathrattle: Summon four 1/1 Skeletons. Any that don't fit give your Undead +1 Attack this game (wherever they are).</li>
	<li>New: Deathrattle: Summon five 1/1 Skeletons. Any that don't fit give your Undead +1 Attack this game (wherever they are).</li>
</ul>

<p>Timewarped Murcules</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: 7/3.</li>
	<li>New: 10/5.</li>
</ul>

<p>Timewarped Squallfin</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: After you play a Murloc, give minions in your hand and board +2/+1.</li>
	<li>New: After you play a Murloc, give minions in your hand and board +2/+2.</li>
</ul>

<p>Timewarped Duskmaw</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: Avenge (1): Give your Dragons +4/+3.</li>
	<li>New: Avenge (1): Give your Dragons +6/+4.</li>
</ul>

<p>Timewarped Bandit</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: At the start of your turn, discard a spell to play 3 Blood Gems on all your minions.</li>
	<li>New: At the start of your turn, discard a spell to play 4 Blood Gems on all your minions.</li>
</ul>

<p>Timewarped Astrogill</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: While this is in your hand, after a different friendly Murloc gains stats, gain +2/+1.</li>
	<li>New: While this is in your hand, after a different friendly Murloc gains stats, gain +3/+2.</li>
</ul>

<p>Timewarped Trumpeter</p>

<ul>
	<li>Old: After you sell 4 Elementals, get a random Elemental. (4 left!)</li>
	<li>New: After you sell 5 Elementals, get a random Elemental. (5 left!)</li>
</ul>

<h4>Timewarp Cost Changes</h4>

<h5>Minor Timewarp</h5>

<ul>
	<li>Timewarped Leapfrogger: Chronum cost changed from 2 to 1.</li>
	<li>Timewarped Snow Elemental: Chronum cost changed from 2 to 1.</li>
</ul>

<h5>Major Timewarp</h5>

<ul>
	<li>Timewarped Whirl-O-Tron: Chronum cost changed from 1 to 2.</li>
	<li>Timewarped Twirler: Chronum cost changed from 1 to 2.</li>
	<li>Timewarped Overfiend: Chronum cost changed from 2 to 1.</li>
</ul>

<h3>Other Changes</h3>

<h4>Anomalies</h4>

<p>These Anomalies have been returned to the Anomaly pool:</p>

<ul>
	<li>Money Match</li>
	<li>Golganneth's Tempest</li>
</ul>

<h2>Bug Fixes & Game Improvements</h2>

<h3>Hearthstone</h3>

<ul>
	<li>You will now be allowed to play Health-cost cards that cost more than your remaining health if you have Arisen Onyxia active.</li>
</ul>

<h3>Battlegrounds</h3>

<ul>
	<li>Fixed a missing comma in Timewarped Painter’s English text.</li>
	<li>Fixed a bug with Power of the Storm where it could offer Rune of Damnation while you were Tier 1.</li>
</ul>
